VALUATION_METHODS._AdditionalDescription:
USPS ADDRESS: The address reported on the appraisal form is according to US Postal Service records as required by UAD format. The title company reports the city or county address and the title report may or may not match to USPS records. Subject was ordered with the address as 968 Grandview Dr, Brigham City UT 84302. The REPC & County data also indicate the address is 968 Grandview Dr, Brigham City UT 84302. The plat map shows the street as Grandview Road. All addresses given are for the subject property.
FINISHED LIVING AREA: The finished living area (gross living area (GLA) and non-GLA area) has been calculated using the Square Footage-Method for Calculating based on the ANSI Z765-2021 Measuring Standard as per Fannie Mae scope of work.
HIGHEST AND BEST USE: The highest and best use of the subject is it's current use of a single family residence. The subject is located in a predominately single family area, conforming to current zoning, any other use would not be feasible or viable.
PLAT MAP DIMENSIONS: The Plat attached with this report was provided by Box Elder County, no other survey or land description beyond the legal description was provided nor available to the appraiser. The plat map dimensions show that the subject has 9000sf. The county data states the subject has .21 Acres or 9148sf. The lot dimensions provided on the plat map are as accurate as provided by the county. Some dimensions may not have been provided on the subjects parcel and were obtained based on surrounding lots dimensions. Appraiser has chosen to rely upon the plat map dimensions.

Verification of SqFt, covered parking and other structural features was made with county records. SALES_COMPARISON._Comment: The comparable sales selected are the most similar disclosed sales. Adjustments reflect the different features as valued by the market and not the cost of the amenity. Typically these differences included: size, parking, baths, fireplaces, jetted tubs, out buildings, etc. Differences in GLA were adjusted $50p/sf, which was derived as follows: Replacement cost new (Marshal&Swift/Local builder) less physical depreciation (ref to cost apprch) less market difference of 65% ($182.7-24%=$138.85-65%=$48.60 ($50r) basement shell at $25p/sf and finish by room count for utility rather than percent of finish. The number of rooms contribute more to value than does the percentage of finish and real estate agents tend to more accurately report the number of finished rooms than correctly estimating the percent of finish. Concessions were adjusted for any amount greater than the 12 month market medium of $8,600. Adjusted value range from sales comparison approach is $415,500 to $453,000(r) See additional comps and comments on next page. See comments on page 3. An attempt was made to bracket all areas of value as the market determines, i.e garage, fireplace, cooling, age, lot size & utility etc. Comparable provided as a bracketing comparable. Comps #5 & #6 are current under contract/active listings provided as part of clients scope of work. No consideration was given these listings as they are not closed sales. It is typical for sellers to pay between $1,243 to $25,000 in buyers closing costs, comps were adjusted at $8,600 the annual median concession paid. In the opinion of this appraiser the comparable sales presented best represent the subjects value.
